top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a complete, independently confirmed discovery chain: Holst on human GLP-1 physiology and incretin action, Mojsov on the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, and Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology. Large randomized outcome trials in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease settle maturity. The three-name allocation is the only coherent one under the ceiling. The open weaknesses are Mojsov's contested priority relative to Habener and colleagues and the exclusion of Knudsen's protraction chemistry. A discovery-scoped citation handles both better than withholding the award, so no award (P000) ranks last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented connection to Drucker, Holst, Mojsov or Knudsen, and shared KI affiliation with other members is not a conflict
